chainAlgorithm: For event n, eventHash = SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing previousHash and every event field except eventHash. previousHash for the first event is the liveLedgerInitialSha256 in the sealed declaration.
rule: This file is append-only and intentionally excluded from the immutable protocol manifest. Any access to confirmatory labels or aggregate results must be appended and externally checkpointed before access. A confirmatory_execution_authorized event must bind runId, exact input-file SHA-256, gate-evidence-file SHA-256, research-corpus SHA-256, analysis cutoff and the remote protocol-manifest SHA-256 before the runner may read the input. Existing events may never be edited or removed; a nonempty ledger without a matching external event-count:tail-hash checkpoint fails verification.
